'''''Star Wars: Vader - Dark Visions''''' is a [[canon]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries focusing on [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]]. The series was written by [[Dennis Hallum|Dennis "Hopeless" Hallum]] and published by [[Marvel Comics]]. The first issue was published on [[March 6]], [[2019]].
